title: Expansion of the four-bit equality polynomial
statement: For every sign vector $x\in\{−1,1\}^4$, the four-bit equality polynomial equals the multilinear polynomial whose coefficient is $-3$ for the empty set, $1$ for each two-element subset of the four coordinates, and $0$ for every other subset.
